name: Saves
summary: Save slots, autosave and the versioned save file; quest progress travels inside the save.

options.name: Synced with the server
options.doc: Offline and server copies reconciled three-way, with play access (catalog saves-conflict-resolution, saves-player-identity-play-access).

parameters.doc: How many manual slots the save/load panel shows; today the template token {{MAX_SAVE_SLOTS}}.

The slot F5 writes and F9 reads. Unset (the default): a dedicated quick slot after the manual slots, titled "Quick save" in the slot list, so F5 never writes over a manual save (PL.quick-slot, U88(5)). Set: that manual slot's number as the player reads it, 1-based (1 is "Slot 1", the old behaviour; PL.quick-slot-one-based, U90(6)); it must be from 1 to maxSlots, or the session refuses it (quick_slot_out_of_range; 0 too) and the game has no quick slot. The session key is quickSlot too (SAVES_PACK_PARAMETERS in save-slots.ts); resolveSaveSlotsConfig maps the number to the session's 0-based slot index, the one place it is mapped.
Seconds between autosaves; 0 turns autosave off.
Show the indicator while an autosave is written.

extensionPoints.signature: ExtensionContract {owner, describe, defaultValue, migrate?} in extensionRegistry (save-extensions.ts)
extensionPoints.doc: Another system's state that rides in currentState.extensions and migrates with the file.

assistant.summary: The save file format, its migrations and the slot messages are core's; the binding writes, reads and shows slots.
notes: Change the slot count, the quick slot or the autosave interval with the parameters, not code. Pass the parameters to resolveSaveSlotsConfig as they are: maxSlots is read as the session's slotCount (SAVES_PACK_PARAMETERS, the one mapping).

The quick slot is dedicated by default: index maxSlots, after the manual slots, stored apart from them (a name of its own, not slot_<index>, so a later maxSlots change never turns the quick save into a manual slot). Report it to the session at that index.

Slot rules (delete, Continue, autosave, F5/F9 quick save and load, the indicator) are core's SaveSlotsSession (save-slots.ts); the binding does the I/O each step names and draws the rows, the indicator and the delete prompt (askDelete, then confirmDelete or cancelDelete). Delete's words are core's SAVE_SLOT_DELETE_WORDS (save-indicator-model.ts): bind the table, never copy the words.
A new system's state goes into the save as a registered save extension (extensionRegistry), never as a new top-level field.
Raise game_saved after a completed write and game_loaded after a read and migration, built with gameSavedEvent / gameLoadedEvent.
doNot: Change SaveFile or SAVE_FILE_VERSION in engine code: the format and its migrations live in core.
Write your own corrupted-slot messages: SLOT_MESSAGES is the shared copy.
